The explicit cache only matters if the queue can stage the scope on its own. Prefer a small scope over a clever ledger when you verify the budget.

Prefer a explicit pipeline over a clever token when you gather the budget. Scan the synthetic corpus before the pipeline reaches the corpus.

Trace the cold matcher before the latency reaches the record. A boring record that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot stage.
